scope.engineering_revision: E v2a single-call source-ID interface and constrained decoding

E.source_id_mapping: reuse lossless v9 sentence offsets; reconstruct quotes in code
E.supported_policy: always keep the exact entering answer
E.unsupported_policy: replace only a changed, source-valid candidate; NQ must be a continuous original span; FEVER must be the opposite legal label
E.insufficient_policy: keep and flag; preserve evidence_conflict as a reason
E.failure_policy: keep and flag incomplete; never invent a verification verdict
E.candidate_failure: preserve independently valid original verdict; full contract compliance may still fail
E.semantic_status: same fallible Qwen; source validity does not establish entailment

engineering_gate.review_line_rule: strictly above the line blocks activation pending review; never force an answer to meet it

deployment_mode.engineering_failed: unavailable: retain answer and flag verification incomplete; no v1 fallback selection
deployment_mode.reference_population: per dataset, fixed T4 Adaptive generation_repair subset; initial/final frozen metric, not utilisation labels
deployment_mode.weighted_net: p_wrong * repair_rate - (1-p_wrong) * harm_rate; equivalently (fixed-harmed)/n on the fixed routed subset
deployment_mode.no_routed_samples: unestimable, default verify_only; never interpret as demonstrated zero risk
deployment_mode.historical_0_28: 9/32 target-utilisation/correct ratio in exposed PRIMARY; not the FEVER ratio, not a universal gate
deployment_mode.diagnostic_candidate_outputs: save raw allow-repair outcomes once; offline derive the frozen deployment mode without new inference

development.cache_full: reuse original pre-E state and first two stages, execute new E on that state; no standalone-E substitution
development.replay: same complete module input, versions, hints and budgets; existing Probe calls only; estimated replay costs are not measured deployment latency
development.review_required_before_candidate_freeze: 15 NQ T4 routing-priority cases with user-confirmed semantics
development.regression_only: five user-reported semantic E harms and 73 initially correct Adaptive keep cases; preserve per-ID review provenance, never effect evidence

routing_search.probe: use existing Diagnosis probability with or without Probe; never add Probe calls or interpret missing Probe as unsupported
routing_search.existing_explicit_supported_probe: fixed veto: retain the original action

selection.primary_decision: positive NQ frozen EM paired net gain over original route with the same frozen E mode
selection.semantic_veto: negative semantic net gain or unresolved judgments able to reverse the nonnegative semantic conclusion => retain original route

final.E_mode_disclosure: if verify_only, label Always Repair and Full as verification without E answer replacement
final.statistics: retain T3 paired statistics, four-comparison Holm family and cost completeness limits
final.AC6: at least 50 flagged samples independently checked; observed incorrect-or-unsupported precision >= 0.90
final.trace_review: at least 50 complete traces; independent requirement from AC6

after_each_round: relevant tests and required full suite
no fabricated human judgments or GPU receipts
